name: Shrimp Scampi with Bacon & Zucchini Noodles

instructions.primary_message: Cut butter into small pieces and place in a small bowl; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make zucchini noodles. Divide noodles between two baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer; dot with ⅓ of the butter and season with salt. (Set remaining butter aside.)
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until zucchini is tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
While the bacon is cooking, peel and thinly slice garlic.
Return the skillet to medium heat; add garlic and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until garlic starts to brown, 2-3 minutes.

Add broth and shrimp to the skillet. Cover and simmer until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the shrimp to a plate (leaving cooking juices in the skillet) and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to the bowl with the remaining butter and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat and simmer sauce until reduced by half, 6-8 minutes.
While the sauce cooks, chop or crumble bacon into pieces.
Juice lemons into the sauce and remove from heat. Stir in the remaining butter, parsley, salt, and pepper. Add shrimp back to the skillet and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide zucchini noodles, shrimp, and sauce between plates. Top with bacon and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
